attributes.norm_statement: One exterior hydrant if the total built area is between 1,000 and 10,000 m². One additional hydrant for every 10,000 m² or fraction thereof.
attributes.satisfied_if: (BUILDING.AREA >= 1000 AND BUILDING.AREA <= 10000 AND EXTERIOR_HYDRANTS == 1) OR (BUILDING.AREA > 10000 AND EXTERIOR_HYDRANTS == (1 + CEILING((BUILDING.AREA - 10000) / 10000)))
